uutiset.t: Anthropic Set for Historic Debut on the Nasdaq
uutiset.s: Anthropic is set to be the biggest IPO of all time. The opening share price keeps rising. The IPO price was $83 per share. Bloomberg's Ryan Gould and Mandeep Singh of Bloomberg Intelligence set the stage for us. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Mexican Peso Hits 17-Month Low as Fed Outlook Rattles Markets
uutiset.s: The Mexican peso sank past the 19-per-dollar mark to its lowest in over a year, as the prospect of further Federal Reserve tightening intensified a selloff fueled by Mexico’s dovish monetary stance.

uutiset.t: Anthropic Executive Team Rings Nasdaq Opening Bell
uutiset.s: Anthropic co-founders and siblings Dario Amodei and Daniela Amodei rang the Nasdaq opening bell, alongside key employees. uutiset.t: Sanofi Weighs Takeover of US Drugmaker Insmed
uutiset.s: Sanofi SA is weighing an acquisition of US drugmaker Insmed Inc., people familiar with the matter said, in what would be the largest biopharma deal in years.

uutiset.t: Xi, Trump and Putin Wrap Historic Trilateral in China
uutiset.s: Chinese President Xi Jinping hosted what he called a “groundbreaking” discussion with Presidents Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin on Thursday in Shenzhen, China. uutiset.t: Ivy League University Endowments Grow to $250 Billion
uutiset.s: Ivy League universities have never been richer. Their combined endowments more than doubled over the past decade to nearly $250 billion.

uutiset.t: Anthropic Poised to Surge After $107.3 Billion IPO Tops SpaceX
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC shares are set to soar when they start trading on Thursday, after the artificial intelligence lab’s $107.3 billion IPO and private placement broke SpaceX’s record for the biggest-ever offering.

uutiset.t: Anthropic IPO Allocates Nothing to Most Institutional Orders
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC’s initial public offering left more than half of the institutional investors bidding for stock without any shares, according to people familiar with the matter.

uutiset.t: US Initial Jobless Claims Unexpectedly Rise by 1,000
uutiset.s: Initial jobless claims in the US rose by 1,000 to 203,000 in the week ending November 14 compared with the median estimate of 198,000. Bloomberg's Enda Curran reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Kalshi, Novig Asks States to Help Bar Problem Gamblers From Prediction Markets
uutiset.s: Even as Kalshi Inc. is fighting dozens of states in court, the prediction market platform is asking the states to help it deal with problem gamblers who want to place wagers on the exchange.

uutiset.t: Senado aprova fiscal em meio a pressões nos ativos
uutiset.s: Daniel Carvalho fala sobre a aprovação do plano fiscal do governo Lula em meio a pressão nos ativos. Com produção de Daniel Carvalho e edição de Patrícia Xavier. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: India Customs Dispute Holds Up $66 Million of Scotch Whisky
uutiset.s: Indian customs authorities are holding up bulk Scotch whisky shipments worth more than £50 million ($65.8 million) at various ports over an import duty dispute, said a person familiar with the matter.

uutiset.t: Ninety One’s Cheveley Sees Commodities Rebound on Supply Woes
uutiset.s: Ninety One portfolio manager George Cheveley is betting on a rebound in commodities over the next year as continued disruptions to global supply chains keep oil and fertilizer markets tight, while gold remains supported by central bank buying.

uutiset.t: Iran Intensifies Hormuz Tanker Attacks Just as Oil Prices Slide
uutiset.s: Iran’s attacks on oil tankers crossing the crucial Strait of Hormuz are getting more intense, just as prices have tumbled due to a flood of supply from the Middle East.

uutiset.t: Argentina’s $24 Billion LNG Dream Bets On Milei's Model Enduring
uutiset.s: Argentina is trying to push through one of the biggest energy investments ever in Latin America. The $24 billion plan to produce vast quantities of liquefied shale gas is a key part of efforts to turn Argentina into a significant world supplier.
